catches: Octoly rebranded to Skeepers; the platform's model is brands gifting products to creators for reviews/content.
Founder/company material on the gifting model states creators received full-size products with 'no monetary compensation.'
There is no cash payout mechanic, commission schedule, or payment timing to verify.
This is a free-products arrangement, not a creator income route — rejected as not an income route.
